entries.jp: バーンシュタイン兵
entries.en: Burnstein Soldier

entries.jp: {v:0001}愚か者め。{n}我々に勝てると思っているのか？
entries.en: {v:0001}Fools. Do you think you can defeat us?

entries.jp: {v:0003}さすがにゲヴェルの作った兵士だ。{n}警備兵では、歯が立たぬか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0003}Just as I would expect of soldiers created by Gevel. Our{n}guards are no match for them...

entries.jp: {v:0004}我々が戦うしかなかろう。
entries.en: {v:0004}We have no choice but to fight them ourselves.
{v:0005}Indeed.

entries.jp: {v:0006}しかし、御二方は昨日から一度も休みなく‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0006}But neither of you has rested even once{n}since yesterday...

entries.jp: {v:0007}我々が引けば、{n}あっという間にここを突破されるであろうが。
entries.en: {v:0007}If we withdraw, they will break through here in{n}an instant.

entries.jp: {v:0008}自分たちがふがいないばかりに‥‥。{n}申し訳ありません。
entries.en: {v:0008}This is all because we are so ineffectual... Forgive us.

entries.jp: {v:0009}相手が相手だ。{n}仕方ないさ。{p}{v:000A}とはいえ、正直疲れてきたな。{n}奴らには疲れはないのか？
entries.en: {v:0009}Given our opponents, you can hardly be blamed.{p}{v:000A}Still, I must admit I am growing tired. Do they{n}never tire?

entries.jp: {v:000B}さあな。{n}ゲヴェルの能力を受け継いでいるとなれば、{n}我々人間をはるかに越えた回復力を持つのかも知れぬ。
entries.en: {v:000B}Who knows? If they have inherited Gevel's abilities,{n}their powers of recovery may far surpass those of{n}us humans.

entries.jp: {v:000C}泣き言を言いたくはないが、こちらが不利だな。
entries.en: {v:000C}I do not wish to complain, but we are at{n}a disadvantage.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:000D}フッ。{n}何があってもお前だけは守ってやる。
entries.en: ...{v:000D}Heh. Whatever happens, I shall at least keep you safe.

entries.jp: {v:000E}美しい友情というところか。{n}だがいつまで他人を気にする余裕があるかな？
entries.en: {v:000E}Such beautiful friendship. But how long can you afford{n}to concern yourself with another?

entries.jp: {v:000F}試してみるか？
entries.en: {v:000F}Care to find out?
...{v:0010}Very well.

entries.jp: {v:0011}ライエル！{n}リーヴス！{n}無事か！？
entries.en: {v:0011}Lyell! Reeves! Are you all right?!

entries.jp: {v:0012}ジュリアンか？
entries.en: {v:0012}Julian?

entries.jp: {v:0013}２人とも無事ですか！？
entries.en: {v:0013}Are you both all right?!
{v:0014}Your Majesty?!

entries.jp: {v:0017}助けに来たよ！
entries.en: {v:0017}We're here to help!

entries.jp: {v:0018}しかし、奴らの力は‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0018}But their strength...

entries.jp: {v:0019}心配しないで下さい。{n}絶対に負けませんから！
entries.en: {v:0019}Please don't worry. We won't lose!
...{v:001A}That girl?!

entries.jp: {FFEE}バーンシュタイン軍の全滅前に敵を倒せ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Defeat the enemy before the Burnstein forces are{n}wiped out!{FFF1}

entries.jp: な、なんだ‥‥。{n}体の力が抜けていく‥‥。
entries.en: W-What...? The strength is draining from my body...

entries.jp: くっ！？{n}ここは退くしかないか‥‥。{n}{s:0000}、任せたぞ‥‥。
entries.en: Ugh?! I have no choice but to retreat...{n}{s:0000}, I leave this to you...

entries.jp: 確かに手応えがない‥‥。{n}あの娘のグローシアンの力が影響しているのか？
entries.en: They certainly offer little resistance... Is that girl's{n}Growsian power affecting them?

entries.jp: ‥‥本当だ。{n}確かに手応えがない‥‥。{n}あの娘のグローシアンの力が影響しているのか？
entries.en: ...You are right. They certainly offer little resistance... Is{n}that girl's Growsian power affecting them?

entries.jp: ん？{n}どういうことだ？
entries.en: Hm? What do you mean?

entries.jp: どうしたんだい？
entries.en: What is it?

entries.jp: さっきまでの手応えがない。{n}これなら、たやすく倒せる。
entries.en: They offer less resistance than before. We can defeat{n}them easily now.

entries.jp: ‥‥なるほど。{n}僕も試してみよう。
entries.en: ...I see. Let me try as well.

entries.jp: おや？{n}これは‥‥。
entries.en: Oh? This is...

entries.jp: どうした？
entries.en: What is it?

entries.jp: さっきまでの手応えが無いんだ。{n}これなら‥‥。{n}これなら簡単に勝てそうだ。
entries.en: They offer less resistance than before. At this rate...{n}At this rate, we should win easily.

entries.jp: 弱くなったというのか？{n}私も試してみよう‥‥。
entries.en: You mean they have weakened? Let me try as well...

entries.jp: ま、まだやれるぞ‥‥。
entries.en: I-I can still fight...

entries.jp: それ以上は無理だ。{n}すぐに下がれ！
entries.en: You cannot take any more. Fall back at once!

entries.jp: すまない、みんな‥‥。
entries.en: Forgive me, everyone...

entries.jp: こいつら、化け物だ‥‥。
entries.en: These things are monsters...

entries.jp: 強すぎる‥‥。
entries.en: They're too strong...

entries.jp: そんな‥‥。{n}誰も守れなかったなんて‥‥。
entries.en: No... I couldn't protect anyone...

entries.jp: {v:0024}もうあいつらはいないみたいね。
entries.en: {v:0024}Looks like that's the last of them.

entries.jp: {v:0025}すごいな‥‥。{n}僕たちが２日戦っても勝てなかった相手を、{n}こんな短時間で‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0025}Incredible... We could not defeat them in two days of{n}fighting, yet you did it so quickly...

entries.jp: {v:0026}これがグローシアンの能力なのか。
entries.en: {v:0026}So this is the power of a Growsian.
...{v:001B}Ugh... What is this...?

entries.jp: {v:001C}あなた達を操る闇の波動を断ち切ってあげる。
entries.en: {v:001C}I'll cut off the waves of darkness controlling you.

entries.jp: {v:001D}く、来るな！{n}うぅ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:001D}S-Stay away! Ugh...

entries.jp: {v:001E}何だか変な感じね？
entries.en: {v:001E}This feels kind of strange, doesn't it?

entries.jp: {v:001F}これが本当のグローシアンの能力。{n}闇の波動から人々を守るの‥‥。
entries.en: {v:001F}This is the true power of a Growsian. It protects{n}people from the waves of darkness...

entries.jp: {v:0020}すごい‥‥。{n}ルイセちゃん、すごいよ！
entries.en: {v:0020}Amazing... Luise-chan, you're amazing!

entries.jp: {v:0021}真のグローシュ？{n}彼女は真のグローシュを手に入れたのか？
entries.en: {v:0021}True Grosh? Has she obtained true Grosh?

entries.jp: {v:0022}本当の‥‥って、真のグローシュってやつ？
entries.en: {v:0022}True power...? You mean that true Grosh thing?

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0023}なんだ、あの娘の力は！？{n}あの娘から、離れて戦わねば‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0023}What is this girl's power?! I must keep my distance{n}from her as I fight...
